self["rspackHotUpdate"]("runtime~main", {},function(__webpack_require__) {

(() => {
// This function allow to reference chunks
__webpack_require__.u = (chunkId) => {
  // return url for filenames not based on template
  if (chunkId === "chunk_js") return "" + chunkId + ".chunk." + __webpack_require__.h() + ".js";
  // return url for filenames based on template
  return "" + chunkId + ".js"
}
})();
// webpack/runtime/get_full_hash
(() => {
__webpack_require__.h = () => ("CURRENT_HASH")
})();
// webpack/runtime/block_chunk_map
(() => {
((blocks) => {
	var map = __webpack_require__.hmrS_blockChunks;
	
	Object.keys(blocks).forEach((blockId) => {
		if (blocks[blockId] === null) delete map[blockId];
		else map[blockId] = blocks[blockId];
	});
	var installedBlocks = __webpack_require__.hmrS_blocks;
	Object.keys(installedBlocks).forEach((id) => {
		if (!map[id]) delete installedBlocks[id];
	});
})({"block:../../../../../../../../packages/rspack-test-tools/dist/helper/hot-update/loader.js!./index.js|dep=esm|./chunk|loc=3:47-64":["chunk_js"]});
